# The view-source timeout attempt moves content preparation outside the macOS menu guard

The attempt moves the content-element lookup, synthetic content click and setTimeout(resolve) before the non-macOS menu guard. macOS now reaches this preparation, while ordinary encoding-menu actions remain guarded; the context-menu path reuses the same element afterward. The timer is a yield, not a checked native focus or menu-readiness condition. Current code retains the placement and later changes ownerGlobal to documentGlobal. No executed macOS result or intermittent-timeout cure is established by this static control-flow check.

Scope: View-source browser-test platform path.
